notes.title: Undelivered - Out Soon!
notes.notes:
What are the crazy chemists doing in their laboratories? Is the military test range near the town really dangerous? What is the doctor’s secret? Undelivered it's a detective quest where you have to find the answers to all these questions and decide the destiny of the town inhabitants!
Please subscribe and add the game to your wishlist.   We look forward to know what you think about our works!
GameChain Team
